Census of India 2011 / Chennai district official profile (chennai.nic.in)

Category: Children (age 1-10) and Persons with Disabilities are NOT included here because they require Census Table C-13 (age data) and C-20 (disability data) respectively - these are state-level files with a Chennai district row embedded in them, not standalone district files. Download C-20 (Tamil Nadu) here: https://censusindia.gov.in/nada/index.php/catalog/43402
No Census has been conducted in India since 2011 (2021 Census was postponed and has not yet occurred), so 2011 remains the latest official figure for these breakdowns.
